title: Business Assistant Agent — Claude + MCP Across Gmail, Shopify and Messenger

sections.label: 1 · EVERYTHING LANDS IN ONE PLACE
sections.note: Email, Messenger and Shopify events all arrive as the same shape, so the assistant learns one task format instead of three. The first filter is aggressive on purpose: most of what hits your inbox is not work, and an assistant that reacts to everything is worse than no assistant.

sections.label: 2 · THE ASSISTANT DECIDES
sections.note: Claude holds each system as an MCP tool rather than having integrations hardcoded around it. That means adding your next system is a tool definition, not a rebuild, and the assistant can chain across them in one task: read the order, check the email thread, draft the reply.

sections.label: 3 · NOTHING GOES OUT UNSEEN AT FIRST
sections.note: Every action is drafted with exactly what it would change before it happens. Low-risk actions run on their own, anything that touches money, a customer, or something irreversible waits for you. As you approve the same thing repeatedly, it moves to the automatic list.

sections.label: 4 · DO IT AND KEEP THE RECEIPT
sections.note: Execution goes through the same MCP tool that proposed the action, so there is one audit trail rather than two. Every run logs what was handled, what was skipped and roughly what it saved you, which is what tells us where to point it next.

input_sample.subject: order 40218 - wrong size again
input_sample.body: This is the second time I've been sent a medium instead of a large. I've got an event on the 22nd. Can you just send the right one out, I'll return the medium.

assistant_plan: Look up order #40218 in Shopify and confirm the size shipped
Check stock on the large before promising it
Draft a reply that apologises, confirms the replacement and includes a prepaid return label
Create the replacement order and flag the repeat error
output_sample.drafted_reply: Hi Hallie, that's twice now and I'm sorry. The large is in stock and going out today so it'll be with you well before the 22nd. Return label attached for the medium, no rush on it.
output_sample.risk_check: Touches a customer and creates an order — held for approval
